audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart tokens gave Akali levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while the whys[] text on the same rows says Garen leads levels 1 through 5. The packet chart (Garen 1-5, Akali 6-7) and the 54.8% Garen win rate over 5312 games both back the text, not the tokens. diff/diffRating also read TRICKY 7/10 for a lane Garen wins.
audit.why: Side tokens and their own explanations pointed opposite directions on four of seven rows, so the chart told the reader to concede stages the text told them to fight.
audit.corrected: Whole chart flipped as one group in both layers to Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Akali/Akali, matching the packet chart, the whys and the win rate. diff set to EVEN and diffRating to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] describes the level-6 spike without the number that makes it actionable — Perfect Execution is 120 seconds at rank 1 and only reaches 60 at rank 3.
audit.why: The whole level-6 decision is whether her R is available; a 120-second first rank is a two-minute window Garen can fight in, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now carries the 120s rank-1 cooldown and keeps the Q-silence into R-execute sequence. Twilight Shroud's 20s rank-1 cooldown added to mid as the trade-window trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places claim Decisive Strike 'denies her Q recast'. Five Point Strike has no recast — it is a 1.5s-cooldown ability gated by energy (110/100/90/80/70). The recast belongs to Shuriken Flip (E). Separately, wants.foe[1] says she uses Shroud to 'break your E channel'; Judgment is not a channel and it is not a targeted spell, so Twilight Shroud's untargetability does not stop it hitting her.
audit.why: Riot's kit text gives the recast to E ('Re-cast to dash to the marked target') and gives R a re-cast; Q's text has no recast at all. And Judgment damages nearby enemies rather than selecting a target, so 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' does not apply to it.
audit.corrected: Silence is now described by what it actually does — it lands mid-combo and her follow-up never comes out — and the Judgment-through-Shroud interaction is stated positively: she cannot use Shroud to break your spin. Assassin's Mark added as the auto-reset tell: when she steps out of the ring around her, the empowered auto is coming.

audit.whatIsWrong: Almost the entire full layer for this matchup is scraped PDF garbage — winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d and report[1]/report[3] all contain the literal string 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 76', bullet artefacts and a level chart pasted into prose fields.
audit.why: These fields render to the user as advice. They are not merely imprecise, they are page furniture from a source document.
audit.corrected: Not repaired here — every one of these is far outside the +/-10% band from any sane replacement, so the applier would reject a rewrite. Flagged in notes for a structural pass.

notes: Two things need a hand pass beyond what the length band allows. (1) The full layer for garen/akali is largely scraped source-document text: winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, report[1].t and report[3].t all contain 'Garen Top Lane Matchup Database (1-70) 76' and/or a level chart pasted into a prose slot. These cannot be repaired inside +/-10% and need regeneration. (2) The mirror audit (akali__garen) already flagged that report[8] tells the reader to rush anti-heal against Garen — Perseverance is out-of-combat regeneration and Grievous Wounds barely touches it. That note stands from this side too. Also: the recast in Akali's kit belongs to Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution, never to Five Point Strike; several fields across this champion may repeat the same 'Q recast' error.
